cast_sheet.look: Branco, Brazil's left-back at the 1990 World Cup: yellow shirt with green collar and cuffs and the number 6, blue shorts, white socks, dark curly hair, thick dark moustache, strong build
an Argentina team physio in 1990: light sky-blue tracksuit with white stripes, a medical bag on his shoulder, short dark hair, sly grin
Claudio Caniggia, Argentina striker 1990: sky-blue and white vertical striped shirt number 8, black shorts, long straight blond hair, slim and fast

beats.say: This bottle of water knocked Brazil out of a World Cup.
beats.scene: close on the touchline at a big floodlit stadium at night in 1990, a plastic water bottle glowing on the grass, crowd blurred behind
Stadio delle Alpi in Turin at night, 1990 World Cup: packed stands, Brazil fans in yellow and Argentina fans in sky-blue and white, floodlights, the pitch from low angle

cast.action: running forward with the ball at his feet, determined

beats.say: The Argentine physio runs on, and Branco asks for a drink.
beats.scene: the touchline in front of the Argentina bench at night, a medical bag on the grass, floodlights

cast.action: holding out a water bottle with a sly grin
reaching out for the water bottle, thirsty, sweating

beats.say: Minutes later he can barely stand.
beats.scene: the middle of the pitch at night, floodlights glaring, the stands a hazy blur

cast.action: dizzy, swaying, a hand on his head

beats.scene: the penalty area in front of the goal at night, the net, the goalkeeper's side of the pitch, floodlights

cast.action: sprinting past the keeper and shooting into the net

beats.say: Argentina win one nil. Brazil go home.
beats.scene: the Argentina fans' end at night, sky-blue and white flags waving, floodlights

beats.say: Years later Maradona admitted it on TV. The water was spiked.
beats.scene: a 2000s television studio set with warm lights and an empty talk-show couch, a big TV screen glowing
